headline: Bitcoin slipped back toward $60,000 as the Nvidia-led stock rally left crypto behind, and US bitcoin funds lost money for a fifth day in a row ahead of Wednesday's US inflation data.

market.asOf: Bitcoin price and 24h change from crypto.news at about 05:56 UTC Tue 24 Nov (12:56 Bangkok); The Block put bitcoin near $60,443. Ether and Solana snapshots could not be confirmed this run. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Sources differ: 9 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's Crypto Fear and Greed Index; 11 per KuCoin's 24 Nov daily market report.

stories.title: Bitcoin drifts back toward $60,000 as stocks rally without it
stories.summary: Asian stock markets surged on Tuesday after Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia's CEO, but bitcoin gave back Monday's jump. Monday's spike to around $64,500 was mostly traders who had bet on a fall being forced to close out, and it faded within hours. Money kept leaving US bitcoin funds.
points: Bitcoin traded as low as $59,603 late Monday and was back near $60,443, per The Block.
Taiwan's Taiex rose more than 9%, South Korea's Kospi 6.5% to 5,014.41 and Japan's Nikkei 3.9% to 58,654.40 on Tuesday, per the Associated Press via The Korea Times.
About $825 million of crypto bets were wiped out over 24 hours, $349 million of them on bitcoin, per CoinGlass data cited by crypto.news.
US spot bitcoin funds lost $569.7 million on Monday 23 Nov, their fifth straight day of outflows; BlackRock's IBIT lost $509.3 million, per Farside data cited by KuCoin.
US spot ether funds lost $84.96 million on Monday, their seventh straight day of outflows, per SoSoValue data cited by KuCoin.

stories.title: Traders bet on a December Fed rate hike; inflation data lands Wednesday
stories.summary: Markets now expect the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates at its 8-9 December meeting. New York Fed President John Williams said he would not rule out raising rates at back-to-back meetings. Wednesday's October PCE inflation report is the next big test.
points: CME FedWatch showed a 95.1% chance of a quarter-point hike in December and 4.9% for a half-point hike, per Stocktwits.
Williams said the Fed "would not exclude moving at consecutive meetings", per Stocktwits.
October PCE inflation is expected at 3.8% a year (September 3.6%) and core PCE at 3.4% (September 3.1%), per ITBeHere's weekly preview.
PCE, the second estimate of Q3 GDP, durable goods and jobless claims all come out Wed 25 Nov at 8:30am ET (20:30 Bangkok); see the calendar below.
US stock markets, and with them US spot crypto funds, are closed on Thursday for Thanksgiving; crypto trades through the holiday.

stories.title: South Korea publishes its draft crypto law
stories.summary: South Korea's government released a draft digital asset law on Tuesday, a broad rulebook for the country's crypto industry. It would allow token sales with a filed white paper, create bank-led won stablecoins and cap how much of an exchange one big owner can hold. It is a draft and still has to pass the National Assembly.
points: Major shareholders of exchanges would be capped at 20%, or up to 34% with approval from the Financial Services Commission, per Bloomingbit; crypto.news reported a 15%–20% range and said no final ceiling had been set.
Existing exchanges would get a 3-year grace period to comply, per Bloomingbit.
Won stablecoins would first be issued by consortiums in which banks hold the majority, with reserves of at least 100%, per Bloomingbit.
Token offerings would be allowed if the issuer files a white paper with the regulator, per Bloomingbit.

briefs.title: US moves to seize $1.17 billion in USDC from the Binance hack
briefs.summary: The Justice Department filed a civil forfeiture complaint for about $1.17 billion in USDC traced to the 29 Oct Binance hack; Circle has frozen the coins and agreed to issue new USDC of the same amount after a court order, per The Block. A court has not ruled yet.

briefs.title: Monad's large MON unlock is today
briefs.summary: About 16.61 billion MON unlock on 24 Nov, mostly to insiders; MON hit a record low before the unlock, per BitcoinWorld. Trackers disagree on the size; see the unlock table on this page for this desk's figure and confidence.

briefs.title: Strategy bought 457 more bitcoin
briefs.summary: Strategy bought 457 BTC for about $29.6 million between 16 and 22 Nov and now holds 851,305 BTC, paid for with sales of its own stock, per its SEC filing.

briefs.title: Strategy and Metaplanet leave MSCI indexes on 30 Nov

briefs.title: Kalshi pauses in Utah
briefs.summary: Prediction market Kalshi paused operations in Utah on 23 Nov while it waits for a court ruling, per The Block; a New York judge had earlier declined to block it there.

briefs.title: Grayscale says crypto looks oversold
briefs.summary: Grayscale's research head Zach Pandl said bitcoin and major altcoins look oversold after a long slide, per The Block. This is one firm's view, not a forecast this desk endorses.
